title: gui: make the diagram canvases interactive — drag nodes anywhere, pan the canvas, zoom, positions persist
description:
User request 2 of the B5 batch (asked 2026-10-17): make the graphs and flow diagrams interactive so the user can move them anywhere they want.

Sibling cards: B5-01 (core directory emitter + CLI), B5-03 (flow + graph interactivity, separate files), B5-05 (GUI Directory panel consumes your interact primitive).
Owner seat: GUI/diagrams (control.rs, types.rs, modules.rs) + a NEW shared file.

Deliverable: one shared interaction primitive and three wired panels.
  * NEW file `crates/gui/src/diagrams/interact.rs`: a reusable canvas interaction layer: pan by dragging empty space; zoom (Ctrl+wheel so it never fights scrolling, plus plain wheel when hovering the canvas with the modifier-free gesture that today only scrolls); and node dragging (a node follows the pointer while the button is down).
  * All three existing diagram canvases (Diagrams: Control flow / Types / Modules) behave this way: grabbing a node moves that node; a drag that starts off-node pans the whole layer; wheel zooms the layer about the cursor; a small Reset button in the existing header row (double-click also) puts the deterministic layout back.
  * Positions persist per view in egui memory (`egui::Id`) keyed by the panel id string, so they survive tab switches within the session. The egui app dies at exit, so no disk file: no schema, no IO.
  * Keep the deterministic layout math intact and as the source of truth for the initial layout (drag offsets per node applied on top). Extract the offset/scale math into pure functions so it can be unit-tested without a UI (the existing repo pattern).
  * Graph mode (egui_graphs) is NOT yours (B5-03 covers it): only the three Diagrams canvases.

Constraints: no new dependencies. Panels must still render correctly after drags, on both themes, and the existing hover/click selection semantics must not break: use movement-threshold detection so a click is still a click. Text selection or multi-select if cheap. Never commit/push; hand to the integrator by message.
